text:
Alia M.: Kicking off partner lab ops runway with Nebula Compute — want to sync NDA redlines, bench plan, and telemetry hooks. Can everyone who will be on-call during the pilot chime in? I put a rough schedule in the doc: https://redwood.internal/partners/nebula/lab-runway

Marco G.: Added comments to the doc. NDA flagged the runtime data retention clause — proposal: telemetry sample-only for first 30 days, then aggregate-only. @Nicole R. PTAL.

Nicole R.: Saw it, agree on 30d sample. Also need a KMS flow for any private keys if we host partner models. I'll escalate to security and request exact scope.

Sam K.: For benchmarks: target 95p latency <200ms at 2 concurrent streams. Plan to run RPS ramp 1→50 over 30m and steady-state for 60m. Canary window = 60m. I'll drop the bench script here after a dry run.

Sam K.: ```
# quick bench example
./run_bench --model nebula-small --qps 50 --concurrency 2 --duration 3600 --telemetry telemetry_run.json
```

Alia M.: Nice. Who owns the telemetry schema? Need field names + an example payload so Nebula can wire up their exporters.

Marco G.: Ops will own the schema. Draft posted: https://redwood.internal/ops/telemetry/schema_v1.md — core fields: run_id, timestamp, seq_len, token_ms, gpu_mem_mb, kv_cache_hits, hw_id. Partner should append hw-specific counters.

infra-bot: Reminder: lab cluster provisioned Tue 10:00 UTC. Image: redwood/lab-nebula:2026-03-25. SSH jump available at jump.redwood.net (access via SSO).

Nicole R.: I'll prepare the KMS policy and share the ARN. Also pushing for a temporary SSO flow for Nebula engineers so they don't need new accounts.

Alia M.: Action items: Marco — finalize telemetry schema and add example payload. Sam — bench script + runbook (include failure modes and golden metrics). Nicole — KMS policy + NDA redline. I'll coordinate partner onboarding call Fri 17:00 PT and invite Nebula + their infra lead. :calendar:

Marco G.: :thumbsup:

Sam K.: I'll run a dry run Wed 09:00 PT and post results here.

Nicole R.: Thanks — will have KMS and NDA comments by EOD Thu.

Alia M.: Perfect. If anyone can't make Fri's call, drop notes in the doc and I'll record the session. cc: @eng-ml for model variant concerns, cc: @partnerships for announcement sync.

(brief bot note) infra-bot: Attached provisioning logs in the doc — lab nodes 1-4 healthy.

Marco G.: One more ask: let's keep a short post-run feedback form for Nebula engineers (3 quick Qs) so we get structured feedback on perf, stability, and onboarding friction. I'll draft it.

Alia M.: Love that. Thanks everyone.
